services.desc: All potential students with no prior Muay Thai experience must complete a 45 minute orientation before doing a Free Trial Class or Signing Up. $45 orientations are only available before you sign up or participate in a class. An orientation is basically a private lesson at a greatly reduced price to help potential students enter a class setting with confidence. All potential students are welcome to take advantage of this special rate, but it is only mandatory for beginners. Our qualified instructors are here to help you achieve your goals whether you are a beginner or a professional fighter.
